news.headline: The drugmaker Abivax has still not been acquired. What's going on?
news.summary: Despite months of AstraZeneca/Eli Lilly takeover speculation and red-hot biotech M&A activity, Abivax remains independent; STAT examines why a deal keeps stalling even as the company advances toward a planned NDA filing and 2027 launch.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback aligning with Abivax's planned NDA submission strategy and the content/format of the filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis; the company remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access, including a Global Head of Marketing from Amgen/Takeda, as it builds out its team ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and potential US launch.

news.headline: Biotech Abivax re-engages investment bank Centerview for Big Pharma takeover talks
news.summary: According to French outlet La Lettre, Abivax re-engaged Centerview Partners to resume takeover talks with Big Pharma suitors including AstraZeneca and Eli Lilly after suspending discussions in June when it secured its $920M capital raise.

news.headline: Abivax's $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the company's $920M ADS offering, which funds operations into Q2 2029, gives Abivax the option to commercialize obefazimod independently in the US rather than needing to sell to a large pharma.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's official IR financial calendar lists H1 2026 results for September 21, 2026, likely to include a pipeline/regulatory update and possible NDA-timeline and M&A-related commentary.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance data at UEG Congress
catalysts.detail: Abivax has a track record of presenting late-breaking Phase 3 ABTECT data at the United European Gastroenterology (UEG) Congress each October; full maintenance data and further subgroup analyses are expected at a major GI congress in Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: US NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following the positive July 2026 pre-NDA FDA interaction, Abivax reiterates it is on track to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) submission
catalysts.detail: Company guidance targets submission of the EU MAA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in this window.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are expected mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026, which should fall shortly after or around the planned NDA submission window.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval and US launch
catalysts.detail: Assuming on-time NDA submission and standard review, potential FDA approval and commercial launch of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis is targeted for H2 2027, with some coverage citing a possible Q3 2027 launch.

pulse: Abivax remains one of biotech's most-watched unconsummated M&A stories: AstraZeneca and Eli Lilly takeover speculation persists (STAT, PharmaVoice) and Abivax re-engaged banker Centerview in July even as the company simultaneously builds independent US commercial infrastructure off its $920M July raise and a positive late-July pre-NDA FDA interaction. The next catalyst is the September 21 H1 2026 results release, which investors will watch for fresh NDA-timeline guidance and any deal-related commentary ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and a possible 2027 US launch.
